title: One bank step acts componentwise
statement: Let $l\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, let $p$ be a valid input-head position for $x$, and choose a single-tape counter configuration $c_i$ for each $i<l$. One step of the bank from their product configuration equals the product configuration formed by taking one counter-machine step on each $c_i$.
replaced: For every input position and family of component configurations, one step of the counter bank equals the product of one single-tape counter step per component: tape contents and independently positioned heads are each updated by their own component, the physical input stays fixed, and all component outputs are suppressed.
